notes: needs_ruling (rule 11): al-Faqih's statement of his routes («فقد رويته عن» and «رويته أيضا عن») to Ibrahim b. Abd al-Hamid, with no saying.
Two levels are both written «محمد بن الحسن»; each has its own «عن», so they are read as two men and not merged (rule 9).
The «- رضي اللّه عنه -» blessings are left out.
